result:
Done. The function uses regex to validate emails for web forms:
- Allows alphanumeric, dots, underscores, percent, plus, hyphen in the local part
- Requires `@` and a domain with at least one dot and 2+ letter TLD
- Rejects empty/non-string input
- Avoids RFC-5321 strictness (which is impractical) while catching obvious invalids

Test cases that work:
- ✓ `user@example.com`, `first.last@example.co.uk`, `user+tag@domain.org`
- ✗ `user@example` (no TLD), `user name@example.com` (space), `@example.com` (no local part)
